texts.orig: To obtain feasible solutions within this simulation-based optimization framework, it is crucial to establish suitable constraints. Constraints are tied to the simulation residuals, which guide the optimization process towards achieving the desired fitness and ensuring numerically stable results. When the residuals are below the specified thresholds, the constraints are deemed satisfied. If the residuals exceed the limits, a penalty is imposed for failing to meet the criteria.
